reason: Provides DSH agents with text-first browser and macOS computer-use automation, including semantic observation, targeted input, OCR, and constrained file uploads.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 智能体提供基于文本观察的 Chromium 浏览器与 macOS 桌面控制能力，包括定向交互、OCR 和受限文件上传。
summaries.en: Provides DSH agents with text-first control of Chromium and macOS interfaces, including targeted interaction, OCR observation, and constrained file uploads.

capabilities: Browser observation and interaction through Chromium, Playwright, CDP, and accessibility/DOM data
Targeted macOS desktop observation and interaction through Accessibility APIs and window-specific input
OCR-based semantic observation for browser and desktop interfaces
Keyboard, pointer, form, scrolling, dragging, and file-upload actions within supported targets
DSH integration exposing computer_observe and computer_action tools
